mqzwry4z.baseName: VeryMerry 5FT Snowhill Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 8 Modes Timer - Warm White
mqzwry4z.variantName: VeryMerry 5FT Snowhill Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 8 Modes Timer - Warm White
mqzwry4z.sourceDescription: PRE-LIT LED TREE DÉCOR: This Snowshill Pre Lit Christmas Tree is a must-have for the festive season. Measuring at 5 feet high with a diameter of 85cm, this tree will have no problems being the centrepiece of your home over the Christmas period. Fitted with 200 warm white LED lights with 8 different light settings and a timer, this tree is sure to be the centre of attention this Christmas. LUXURY FINISH: The gorgeous ever-green tree is finished with 547 tips to ensure that it always looks thick, bushy and plump. The tips also allow you to dress the tree with your chosen decorations with ease. Please note that some time will need to be spent arranging the tree to achieve the desired look. STURDY BASE: This festive tree comes with a sturdy metal base which ensures your tree is always fully balanced and remains in place whilst in use. The tree is made up of 3 different sections complete with hinged branches making it hassle-free to assemble, dismantle and store away. LONG-LASTING: This beautiful Christmas tree is made from high-quality PVC which not only gives the tree a more realistic look, but it also means that this tree can be used for many years due to its high durability. This product is made with fire resistant material to provide you and your home with extra safety. DIMENSIONS: This tree stands at 5 feet high and has a diameter of 85cm. WEIGHT: 6KG Please refer to the product packaging and user manual for applicable safety warnings and instructions. Consumable Direct Ltd, 78 Cawdor St, Eccles, Manchester, M30 0QF

ys9v4a3k.variantName: My Christmas 4ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 130 LED Lights - Green
ys9v4a3k.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this 120cm artificial Christmas tree, featuring 320 PE and PVC branch tips for a full, realistic appearance inspired by a freshly cut evergreen. The two-tone foliage combines light green outer tips with darker inner needles to create natural depth and texture. Its hinged branches drop into place for quick assembly and fold back for compact storage after the festive season. With integrated LED lights, you can choose from eight lighting effects using the included remote control, adjust the brightness, set a 6-hour timer with an 18-hour automatic shut-off cycle, and switch the lights on or off with ease. The flame-retardant foliage and sturdy metal trunk provide durability and reliable support for your favourite Christmas decorations. Ideal for living rooms, lounges, offices and entryways, this pre-lit tree makes it easy to create a festive atmosphere. Specifications: Made from PE and PVC with 320 branch tips, integrated LED lights, eight lighting modes, remote control, adjustable brightness, a 6-hour timer, an 18-hour automatic shut-off cycle, hinged branches and a sturdy metal trunk. Dimensions: Height: 120cm. Width: 65cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

8myz491r.baseName: Walplus 300 LED String Lights Slim Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
8myz491r.variantName: Walplus 300 LED String Lights Slim Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
8myz491r.sourceDescription: This Slim Christmas Tree with LED Light is a modern seasonal décor piece that seamlessly fits into compact living spaces, bringing festive spirit wherever it's displayed. Accessible and versatile, it's suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a delightful visual appeal through its cone-shaped stature and warm lighting. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this Christmas tree offers a realistic appearance and robust durability, perfect for supporting decorations and lights year after year. Combined with a metal base for added stability, it ensures the tree stands tall and secure without wobbling, enhancing its overall longevity and sturdiness, making it a reliable choice for holiday decorating. Included Components: Equipped with intricate strands of decorative LED string lights, the tree emits a warm white glow, creating a cozy ambiance. These lights are powered via a USB connection, providing versatile power options and making it ideal for various setups whether near a power outlet or connected to portable power banks, ensuring seamless integration into your festive settings. Features /Function /Design: Tailored for modern homes, this tree's slim design is perfect for those seeking a space-efficient solution. Its simple yet elegant construction allows it to fit neatly against walls, corners, or even tabletops, maximizing space while bringing a touch of nature. The modern style harmonizes with a variety of interior décors, enhancing your home's festive presentation. Recommended Uses: Whether displayed in a living room, garden, or terrace, this tree is perfectly suited for creating holiday cheer in any environment. Its elegant lighting effect makes it a superb choice for evening gatherings, fostering a warm and inviting atmosphere for family and guests during the festive season. Care &Maintenance: To protect your decorative investment, place a cover over the tree when not in use to shield it from dust and potential damage. This simple precaution will help maintain the tree's appearance and functionality year after year, ensuring it remains a cherished part of your holiday tradition. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and solid pine wood Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 77 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Durable Decorative with pine cones and ornament balls, Lifelike branch tips, Real wood trunk Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on Number of PVC tips: 465 Number of pine cones: 45 Number of baubles: 120 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

3sfz0c09.baseName: Harbour Housewares Classic Real Christmas Tree Stand - Black
3sfz0c09.variantName: Harbour Housewares Classic Real Christmas Tree Stand - Black
3sfz0c09.sourceDescription: Deck the halls in style this holiday season with this Classic Christmas Tree Stand from Harbour Housewares. Designed to hold real trees up to 5.5 foot tall and with a trunk diameter of up to 3 inches, this sturdy stand pairs hardwearing plastic with metal legs built to keep your spruce standing proud from first night to last! The 0.9 litre capacity of the in-built water holder will keep your fir tree fed throughout the festive season, maintaining full volume and luscious vibrant green needles. Best of all, this stand can be quickly dismantled come the start of the new year for convenient, space-saving storage. Caution: place on a stable, level surface and ensure the tree is securely fastened before use. Check regularly for stability. Rinkit SAS, 6 Rue de la Mare Blanche, France, sales@rinkit.com
